title: Modified Xuan-Bi-Qing-Ying decoction alleviates septic liver injury by regulating autophagy and apoptosis via HIF-1alpha signaling pathway.
authors: Yan, Jing; Pan, Yifeng; Liu, Zhu; Chen, Yulin; Hu, Kai; Liu, Yuanyuan; Wang, Guangyao; Li, Liqun; Xie, Sheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药方剂对脓毒症肝损伤的保护作用，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白（HIF-1alpha）互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Xuan-Bi-Qing-Ying Decoction (XBQYD), a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formula modified based on clinical experience, has demonstrated efficacy and safety in the treatment of septic liver injury (SLI). METHODS: The absorbed components of XBQYD were characterized in vivo using LC-MS/MS. A rat model of septic liver injury (SLI) was then established by cecal ligation and puncture. To evaluate the preventive efficacy of XBQYD, rats were pretreated with the formula for seven days prior to injury induction. Subsequently, we evaluated liver histopathology (HE staining), measured serum inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha), oxidative stress markers (MDA, SOD) with commercial kits, and assessed liver function via biochemical analysis. To investigate the mechanism, network pharmacology was combined with Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis, which identified HIF1A as a core predicted target. Based on this prediction, the influence of XBQYD pretreatment on the HIF‑1alpha pathway was measured in liver tissue at both mRNA and protein levels, along with its downstream effects on autophagy and apoptosis. Finally, molecular docking and dynamics simulations were used to investigate potential direct interactions between key XBQYD constituents and HIF-1alpha. RESULTS: A total of 22 bioactive components derived from XBQYD were identified in vivo. In SLI rats, pretreatment with XBQYD significantly mitigated liver histological damage, decreased pro-inflammatory cytokine levels and oxidative stress, and restored liver function. Network pharmacology revealed 233 intersecting targets of XBQYD and SLI. KEGG and PPI analyses highlighted the HIF-1 signaling pathway and 50 core targets, including HIF1A. MR analysis confirmed that HIF1A may increase the risk of sepsis and sepsis-related 28-day mortality. This preventive effect was associated with the inhibition of the HIF-1alpha pathway activation by XBQYD pretreatment, which correlated with enhanced autophagy and suppressed apoptosis. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations demonstrated stable interactions between key XBQYD constituents (Quercetin, Delphinidin, and Azaleatin) and HIF-1alpha. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrates that pretreatment with XBQYD exerts a preventive effect against SLI in rats by inhibiting the HIF-1alpha signaling pathway. These findings provide a mechanistic basis for considering XBQYD as a potential preventive strategy for SLI.
abstract_zh: 背景：宣痹清营汤（XBQYD）是一种基于临床经验改良的中药（TCM）方剂，在治疗脓毒症肝损伤（SLI）中已显示出疗效和安全性。方法：采用LC-MS/MS在体内表征了XBQYD的吸收成分。随后通过盲肠结扎穿刺建立脓毒症肝损伤（SLI）大鼠模型。为评估XBQYD的预防效果，在诱导损伤前对大鼠进行为期七天的方剂预处理。随后，我们评估了肝脏组织病理学（HE染色），使用商业试剂盒测量血清炎症细胞因子（IL-1beta、IL-6、TNF-alpha）、氧化应激标志物（MDA、SOD），并通过生化分析评估肝功能。为探究机制，将网络药理学与孟德尔随机化（MR）分析相结合，确定HIF1A为核心预测靶点。基于此预测，在mRNA和蛋白水平上测量了XBQYD预处理对肝脏组织中HIF-1alpha通路的影响，及其对自噬和凋亡的下游效应。最后，使用分子对接和动力学模拟研究XBQYD关键成分与HIF-1alpha之间可能的直接相互作用。结果：在体内共鉴定出22种源自XBQYD的生物活性成分。在SLI大鼠中，XBQYD预处理显著减轻了肝脏组织学损伤，降低了促炎细胞因子水平和氧化应激，并恢复了肝功能。网络药理学揭示了XBQYD与SLI的233个交集靶点。KEGG和PPI分析突出了HIF-1信号通路和50个核心靶点，包括HIF1A。MR分析证实HIF1A可能增加脓毒症及脓毒症相关28天死亡率的风险。这种预防效应与XBQYD预处理抑制HIF-1alpha通路激活相关，该抑制与增强的自噬和抑制的凋亡相关联。分子对接和动力学模拟表明，XBQYD关键成分（槲皮素、飞燕草素和杜鹃花素）与HIF-1alpha之间存在稳定相互作用。结论：我们的研究表明，XBQYD预处理通过抑制HIF-1alpha信号通路，在大鼠中对SLI发挥预防作用。这些发现为将XBQYD视为SLI的潜在预防策略提供了机制基础。
